sloka: तस्य आलय वरिष्ठस्य मध्ये विपुलम् आयतम् ।ददर्श भवन श्रेष्ठम् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः ॥५-९-१॥
transliteration: tasya ālaya variṣṭhasya madhye vipulam āyatam ।dadarśa bhavana śreṣṭham hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ ॥5-9-1॥

translations.english: The son of the Windgod, Hanuman, saw a huge, spacious and excellent of all mansions in the centre of the palace.
